name: Property Core for ChatGPT

repository.note: ChatGPT never clones or runs anything. The connector's own instructions carry the guide.

integrations.name: Property Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the hosted service. The host types the invite code from Saad on the approval page and clicks Allow. One connector serves both services.
integrations.where: ChatGPT Settings → Apps → Developer Mode → Create. Never add it a second way.
